messages:
marta: RCA is live: link https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-4021
marta: Brief: misrouted canary traffic + unexpected cache eviction during a config rollout produced repeated fallbacks for a subset of Dedicated pools. Impact ~33m; degrading p95 for some customers.
leo: Thanks. Can we enumerate the concrete action items and owners?
marta: Actions: A1: Add rollout compatibility check (owner: leo) | ETA: 1 week. A2: Expose cache eviction thresholds in runtime config + defaults (owner: sam) | ETA: 10 days. A3: Add fallback-loop detector alert (owner: ops-bot) | ETA: 5 days. A4: Update rollout runbook to include post-rollout traffic validation (owner: marta) | ETA: 3 days.
sam: Taking A2. Will open config PR today and add a brief docs note.
leo: Taking A1. Will add preflight and unit tests; will also add a light canary verification step to the pipeline.
ops-bot: A3 scheduled: will add Grafana panel and a low-priority pager if fallback-rate >0.3% over 5m.
incident-bot: RC-4021 created by marta. Title: "Canary routing + cache eviction -> fallback loop" https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-4021
marta: Checkpoints: 1-week sync 2025-05-09 09:00 PT, 30-day review 2025-06-06 09:00 PT. Invites to follow.
leo: I'll post PR link once ready.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/823 (config + docs).
marta: Please drop PR links here so we can mark closure in the RCA.
leo: PR for rollout check: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/621 (WIP).
ops-bot: Dashboard panel added: https://grafana.internal/d/XYZ/fallbacks (linked in RCA).
marta: Thank you all. We'll reconvene at the 1-week checkpoint and close remaining items. If anything blocks, post here or DM. :white_check_mark:
